# Cardano and Blockfrost fixture contracts

These are synthetic indexed responses and ordinary payment vectors, not mined
transactions or live qualification. Payment CBOR is generated by pinned maintained
Pallas Conway encoding. The fake witness has a public key matching the selected
input credential and zero signature bytes: it tests body/shape correlation only.
No cryptographic verification or funded submission is asserted.

Primary contracts checked on 2026-10-07:

- [Blockfrost current OpenAPI](https://github.com/blockfrost/openapi/blob/master/openapi.yaml), version 0.1.93: all Cardano indexed data and hosted `POST /tx/submit` require explicit `project_id`; only health is explicitly keyless. Submission is raw `application/cbor` and responds with a JSON transaction-hash string. Its synthetic examples are not usable live transaction IDs.
- [Pallas 1.4.0 Conway model](https://docs.rs/pallas-primitives/1.4.0/pallas_primitives/conway/index.html): maintained body, witness-set, original-CBOR codec and hash primitives. The body hash uses original bytes, never normalized re-encoding.
- [Current db-sync Conway transaction mapping](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-db-sync/blob/master/cardano-db-sync/src/Cardano/DbSync/Era/Shelley/Generic/Tx/Conway.hs): valid transactions pay the declared body fee; failed-script transactions pay encoded total collateral when supplied, otherwise the indexer's collateral-input calculation. Declared body fee and source paid fee remain separate.
- [CIP-55](https://cips.cardano.org/cip/CIP-0055) and [Babbage ledger TxOut](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-ledger/blob/master/eras/babbage/impl/src/Cardano/Ledger/Babbage/TxOut.hs): ordinary minimum ADA is `(160 + encoded output bytes) * coinsPerUTxOByte`.
- [CIP-14 fingerprint](https://cips.cardano.org/cip/CIP-0014), [CIP-19 addresses](https://cips.cardano.org/cip/CIP-0019), [CIP-129 DRep IDs](https://cips.cardano.org/cip/CIP-0129).

The implemented preparation profile is Conway protocol major 9 or 10, ordinary
key-spend ADA/native-asset payments. All inputs, destinations/change outputs,
fee, validity slots, network tag/magic and witness count are caller-selected.
No coin selection, script execution, signing, custody, clock-based expiry or
implicit submission occurs. Unsupported script/Byron spends and extra witness
families return explicit unsupported capability. Network tag is encoded; a
specific testnet magic is not encoded in a Shelley transaction and is checked
against configured source genesis before outgoing operations.

Every backend operation verifies expected genesis magic under one total budget.
Read retries keep exactly the same path/page parameters. Submission has exactly
one raw-CBOR dispatch and distinguishes safe preflight failures from uncertain
post-dispatch outcomes. Ack is not execution or finality. Indexed state and pages
can change between requests and are not a hash-selected snapshot.

Bounds: 2 MiB HTTP response ceiling, 64 KiB original CBOR, depth 64, 8192 CBOR
items, 64 body/witness map fields, at most 1000 transaction input/output records;
pages at most 100. Preparation has at most 100 selected inputs, outputs and key
witnesses and 256 assets per output. Excess fails the whole operation; no truncation.
Source metadata text retains at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, including controls escaped
by serde/Debug. Arbitrary on-chain metadata has explicit unavailable/null/present
uninterpreted classification; it is not exported as a generic JSON object.

Run offline fixtures with:

```sh
cargo test --offline --locked --no-default-features --features blockfrost-http \
  --test cardano --test cardano_execution --test blockfrost --test blockfrost_operations
cargo test --offline --locked --no-default-features --features blockfrost-http \
  --lib transport::http::write_tests
```

The ignored `blockfrost_live` test calls all 17 read/estimate operations and pure
preparation/review using explicit input. It never submits. Supply these variables:

| Variable suffix (`REGIT_WEB3_BLOCKFROST_`) | Explicit input |
| --- | --- |
| `URL` | Full versioned Cardano API base URL |
| `PROVIDER_ID` | Non-secret source label |
| `PROJECT_ID` | Credential, supplied only through the test-owned environment |
| `NETWORK_TAG`, `NETWORK_MAGIC`, `NETWORK_ALIAS` | Expected network identity |
| `ADDRESS`, `STAKE_ADDRESS` | Existing matching payment/reward addresses |
| `ASSET_UNIT` | Existing full policy+asset-name hexadecimal token identity |
| `TRANSACTION_ID` | Existing indexed transaction with supported original CBOR framing |
| `EPOCH` | Exact numbered indexed epoch |
| `PAYMENT_INTENT_JSON` | Explicit serialized balanced supported `PaymentIntent` |

The harness uses 5-second connect/20-second total deadlines, 2 MiB bodies, two
safe-read retries and pages of two records. Credentials are never printed and
never loaded by the library. Missing credentials, actual 403, discovery, health
and synthetic fixtures do not qualify indexed reads.

```sh
cargo test --offline --locked --no-default-features --features blockfrost-http \
  --test blockfrost_live -- --ignored --nocapture
```
